title: ネットワークとセキュリティ演習
subtitle: Network and Security Laboratory
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn practical techniques related to information networks and information security through programming exercises. (2) Learn how to program TCP sockets and application protocols. (3) Learn how to program cryptography and authentication.
advice: This is a course in which students will learn programming techniques related to information network technology and information security technology. We will cover the following materials: - C programming on Linux - Network program mechanism - TCP socket - Application layer protocols - Network programming - Cryptographic programming - Hash programming - Authentication programming - Creating application programs
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of the knowledge/skills of "Information network" and "Information security." Enough skill of C programming.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create network programs using TCP sockets.
Be able to use existing cryptographic and authentication programs.
Be able to create cryptographic or authentication programs using cryptographic libraries.
Be able to create original programs that utilize network and security technologies.
